title: SmpRecipes
description: A custom recipe plugin for webs,anvil,golden apple
body:
A plugin that adds the basic recipes for SMPs

A cobweb from 5 string placed in an X

A golden apple from 1 apple and 4 golden ingots placed in an + 

And 1 anvil from 7 iron ingots placed in the same slots as the normal anvil
